status: C revision design proposals; no production homepage source changes in this revision

decisions.sideEntries: Reserve two optional buttons on each side. Sign-in/ranking/events/tasks are illustrative future features only. Do not show empty buttons. If more entries are needed, group low-frequency features under More.
decisions.partnerStrip: Show next unlock while there are uncollected available partners. When every available partner is collected, show 全员集结 / 小队伙伴已集齐; tapping opens the existing codex. Restore next-partner preview when new characters become available. Keep the start button position fixed.

variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, precise layout revision of the supplied mobile game homepage.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, concept C of the Chinese game 泡泡小队. Preserve its exact plush art direction, five characters, fluffy lavender cloud stage, pastel stitched logo, sunny yellow Start button, cream bottom dock, and lavender settings/album buttons.
Create one polished full-bleed portrait homepage with the same 910:1730 aspect ratio. No phone frame, no comparison board. The user's feedback: the original is too crowded to add future buttons. Redesign the spatial layout to comfortably fit four optional future quick-entry buttons without covering the characters.

Exact layout:
- Keep small settings at top-left within safe margins, label 设置, top-right blank for platform chrome.
- Scale the stitched title 泡泡小队 down to approx 70% of viewport width, centered, y=12–25%. Keep the small subtitle 毛绒伙伴 · 一起出发. Preserve lettering/material but give it breathing room.
- Scale the FIVE-ANIMAL group down to approx 66% of viewport width, centered within x=17–83%, y=34–69%. The sleepy orange capybara and yellow chick are behind; green frog front left, blue teddy center closest, purple elephant front right. All emerge from their original matching felt pots with two green leaves, no human bodies. Do not remove any animal. Do not alter their identities. Keep a softly lit lavender cloud-cushion stage and a few quiet bubbles, not busy stars in the margins.
- Clearly reserve BOTH lateral columns x=3–15% and x=85–97% from y=38–64% for two comfortable icon-with-label entries on each side. Show four illustrative future feature buttons to prove there is space: left at y=41% a small cream calendar icon label 签到; left at y=56% a soft trophy icon label 排行; right at y=41% a little gift icon label 活动; right at y=56% a small checklist icon label 任务. These are tasteful low-emphasis optional entries, each about 11% screen width, in the game's felt/plush palette. They must never overlap the group. Large enough for thumb tapping, but secondary to Start. The four examples are layout demonstration only. No red dots, badges, prices, currencies or event banners.
- Bottom cream dock occupies y=78–100%, substantially unchanged style. In its upper part y=80–88%, make next-partner info a compact strip: small peach rabbit in a bubble on left and exact two-line text 新伙伴 小霞 / 通关这一关就来啦！ on right. Smaller than the original huge rabbit.
- Start CTA fixed at bottom y=90–98%, left x=7–72%, bright yellow, exact text 开始游戏 with smaller 第5关. Album square to its right x=78–94%, exact text 图鉴. Good touch gaps, no overlap, clear 3D edges.
- Must keep title, animal group, four side-entry icons and bottom dock distinct with generous negative space. Original should become visibly calmer and more extensible, not a wall of buttons. Preserve the premium textile textures and soft warm lighting.

Chinese text precisely as provided. No explanatory annotations or version names within the screenshot, no additional UI or features, no watermark.

Change ONLY the compact partner-information strip directly above the Start button (approximately y=76–85% of screenshot):
